answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 19723 Country: India Title: My wife after few years of marriage filed criminal cases against me and my family members and I also filed cases. Now the matter has been compromised and for settlement I have to pay a huge sum for withdrawal of cases and final settlement, I have finally given Talak to her. The amount is much higher which runs into lakhs of rupees, my question is Whether I can give interest received from Bank in excess of amount of Iddat and maintenance. Your early reply in this regard shall be help me in the right direction. Question: Mufti Saheb Aaslam Alaikum, My wife after few years of marriage filed criminal cases against me and my family members and I also filed cases. Now the matter has been compromised and for settlement I have to pay a huge sum for withdrawal of cases and final settlement, I have finally given Talak to her. The amount is much higher which runs into lakhs of rupees, my question is Whether I can give interest received from Bank in excess of amount of Iddat and maintenance. Your early reply in this regard shall be help me in the right direction. Thanking you in advance. Wassalam. Answer ID: 19723 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 347/284/M=1431) In the abovementioned case, it is unlawful to give the interest money received from bank. This interest should not be spent therein. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
